user.title: Connect to Gotify MU
user.description: Enter the Channel application token used by Home Assistant to send notifications. Optionally add a client token to enable realtime inbound messages. Current Gotify MU servers identify the Channel automatically.

data_description.server_url: Base URL of the Gotify MU server.
data_description.app_token: Application token for the Channel used by Home Assistant to send messages.
data_description.client_token: Optional Gotify MU client token. Required only for realtime inbound/two-way messages.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only for a trusted private server using a self-signed or otherwise untrusted certificate.

channel.title: Choose the Gotify MU Channel
channel.description: This server does not expose application-token identity. If a client token was supplied, choose the Channel associated with the application token. Otherwise enter a display name.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Gotify MU
reauth_confirm.description: The stored Gotify MU credentials are no longer accepted. Replace the application token and, if needed, the client token.

data_description.client_token: Leave blank to keep the existing client token.
data_description.remove_client_token: Removes inbound/two-way access and disables the inbound stream.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Gotify MU
reconfigure.description: Update network, display, and optional inbound-message settings for this Gotify MU Channel.

data_description.client_token: Leave blank to keep the existing client token.
data_description.remove_client_token: Removes inbound/two-way access and disables the inbound stream.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Gotify MU.
error.invalid_auth: Gotify MU rejected the supplied credentials.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// Gotify MU server URL.
error.rate_limited: Gotify MU rate limited the validation request. Try again shortly.
error.channel_not_accessible: The configured client token cannot access this Gotify MU Channel.
error.wrong_channel: The application token belongs to a different Gotify MU Channel.

abort.already_configured: This Gotify MU Channel is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Gotify MU authentication was updated successfully.
abort.setup_state_lost: Setup state was lost. Start the integration setup again.
abort.channel_not_found: The selected Gotify MU Channel is no longer available.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The supplied settings identify a different Gotify MU Channel.

init.title: Gotify MU options
init.description: Native pairing status: {native_state}. Choose what you want to manage.

settings.title: Gotify MU options
settings.description: Control notification priority and realtime inbound message handling.

data_description.default_priority: Default Gotify priority used by the notify entity.
data_description.inbound_enabled: Maintain a Gotify MU WebSocket connection and expose incoming Channel messages as a Home Assistant event entity.

native_pairing.title: Native Home Assistant pairing
native_pairing.description: Status: Paired. The native bridge can exchange Home Assistant events with Gotify MU without a Home Assistant Long-Lived Access Token.

native_pair.title: Pair with Gotify MU server
native_pair.description: Enter the one-time pairing code generated by Gotify MU. The code expires after 15 minutes and can only be used once. Home Assistant will use its configured URL automatically when one is available.

data_description.home_assistant_url: Base URL that the Gotify MU server can reach. This is requested only when Home Assistant cannot determine a usable URL automatically.

native_remove.title: Remove native pairing
native_remove.description: This removes only the native Gotify MU bridge credentials. Notifications, optional client-token inbound messages, entities, and the normal Gotify MU integration remain configured.

error.invalid_pairing_code: The Gotify MU pairing code is invalid or was already used.
error.pairing_expired: The Gotify MU pairing code has expired. Generate a new code in Gotify MU.
error.pairing_failed: Gotify MU could not complete native pairing. Generate a new pairing code and try again.
error.invalid_ha_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// Home Assistant URL reachable by Gotify MU.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Gotify MU to complete native pairing.
error.rate_limited: Gotify MU rate limited the pairing request. Try again shortly.

send.name: Send notification
send.description: Send a notification through a configured Gotify MU Channel.
